groups.name: Oscillator Core
groups.description: Foundation of all sound - determines timbre before filtering
groups.hipHopTip: Start with sawtooth mask for leads, sine+fundamental for sub bass

groups.name: Filter Character
groups.description: Shaping and sculpting the sound - unique in additive engine
groups.hipHopTip: Use high resonance without fear - no phase artifacts in Harmless

groups.name: Envelope Shaping
groups.description: Temporal control - attack, body, sustain, and release behavior
groups.hipHopTip: Plucks: 0ms attack, 0% sustain. Pads: 200ms+ attack, 80% sustain

groups.name: Movement & FX
groups.hipHopTip: 20+ Hz phaser rate creates alien pitch effects on high notes

groups.name: Width & Power
groups.description: Stereo width and thickness through voice stacking
groups.hipHopTip: 3-4 voices for tight bass, 7+ for supersaw leads

groups.name: Polish Chain
groups.hipHopTip: Maximus adds punch, Crush adds lo-fi character
